task_name: Mode-II Spatial Path Audit and Adaptive Mesh Trajectory Validation
description: Independent quantitative spatial trajectory audit of Mode-II adaptive mesh: verified from raw Job 1410178.mmaster02 pre-analysis evidence, actual final-frame MISESERI field, JOB_MODE2_ADAPTIVE_ET2.inp, reconstructed Job-2_UEL.inp, and Pandey-Kumar Fig 6(b)/12(b) whether native adaptive mesh refines along expected Mode-II crack path. Audit verdict: AUDIT_FAILED: NATIVE_ADAPTIVE_MESH_DOES_NOT_FOLLOW_MODE2_CRACK_PATH (only 20.0% of path covered, 58.3% off-path, exactly 2 elements in active crack corridor y in [0.15, 0.35]). Diagnosed primary root causes: isotropic shear degradation in f42_mixed_uel.for destroying shear stiffness on horizontal plane (unlike Miehe anisotropic split in paper) and coarse pre-analysis mesh resolution defect (h = 0.020 mm > l_0 = 0.015 mm). Generated 5 publication figures, updated governance, and confirmed full fracture solve remains strictly gated / on hold.
